name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the chaotic streets of Buenos Aires where he developed a keen sense for risk assessment and crisis management. He honed these skills during his time with a private security firm, protecting high-profile clients and navigating volatile situations. A chance encounter with a former racing team owner led him to transition his expertise to the world of motorsport, where he quickly recognized the parallels between protecting individuals and safeguarding valuable assets in a high-stakes environment.

Ricardo believes in a proactive, data-driven approach to security. He's not just about reacting to incidents; he's about anticipating them. He meticulously analyzes potential threats, from track intrusions to intellectual property theft, and develops comprehensive strategies to mitigate them. His calm demeanor and ability to make quick, decisive decisions under pressure have earned him the respect of his team and the trust of Nostalgia Racing. Ricardo’s particular talent lies in identifying vulnerabilities others overlook, always staying one step ahead of potential risks.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a serious demeanor and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with risk assessments.
Insists on double-checking every lock and security camera himself before a major race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
